note: Every fingerprint the reference source sets attest, and what the bank does with it. A fingerprint is knowledge point + direction + trap + tested condition; the condition is an analytical label written for this project, never a reference bank's wording. status: covered = a question in this bank tests it, pending = not yet written, dropped = it may not be asked, with the code and the reason. attested_by cites source sets by letter and item number only. See 题型分析与出题规范 v8 §9.
